text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah! We've finally made it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Look at that! It's a bit old, but this inn is spectacular!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yep, it might be rustic but it's clean as a whistle! That's how you know they're taking good care of it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and I are in the middle of our hot spring vacation. It all happened pretty suddenly when she accosted me and declared…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer! It's time to bust out our secret treasure stash!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's right, I'm talking about the hot spring coupon! Now's the time to use it!
choice_data_list: You're right. It's about to expire.
You're right. It's about to expire.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Plus, it's time we take a break and reward ourselves with some rest and relaxation…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not! That's what you thought I was gonna say, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's right! Everyone else might be dropping their guards since things have quieted down, but my fight continues!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This trip is where we kiss the laziness lurking inside us goodbye! Goodbye laziness, hello productivity! Now let's go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So that's how we ended up here. It's still pretty early, so I suggest we start out with some sightseeing.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice idea! Let's go say hi to the staff too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you for welcoming us so warmly! This place is so clean, I feel like I could eat off the floors!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's even more hyper than usual. No matter what I say, I get the feeling she'll just drag me to wherever she wants to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some sightseeing, we return to the hot spring for a nice soak. Following that…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaah, that felt so good! There's nothing like a hot bath to get your fighting spirit blazing again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You know what I'm talking about, right? I bet you do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes the passion from the bath and…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When I surged forward at the end, it was like the engine of my soul was going full throttle! That race was the best! And then, do you remember when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her voice booms through the inn as she recounts race after race. They're told with such fervor that I can't help but be sucked in. However…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And we've got plenty more memories like that to come! Yeaaah! The springtime of our youth will last foreveeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm starting to get a little worried. If she stays wound up for much longer, there's no way she'll be able to fall asleep tonight…
choice_data_list: How about we watch some TV?
How about we watch some TV?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's a good idea! Even regular TV seems way more special when you're watching at an inn!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's a high school drama! I wonder what the story's about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I see! So it's about a red-hot cheer squad leader who clashes with the other students and how that brings them all closer as friends!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Dang, that's so cool! The main character is just like me! I didn't know they made this kind of show these days!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If the main character is me… that makes the strong, quiet one Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And the super serious member of the karate club is Yaeno! And the younger student who puts their all into everything is Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And the no-nonsense, strong-willed library assistant's gotta be Ardan. So that leaves… Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I just realized… there's no you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If there were a teacher filled with red-hot passion, maybe that would work for you… Nah, that's not quite right.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I guess you could be the tough coach… Nope, that won't work either 'cause you're way more nice than you are strict.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Maybe you're the reliable best friend? That's not it either. You're not just reliable, you're really understanding and open-minded too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… It's really hard to pin down what you are to me… Give me a second!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Trainer is always guiding me and thinking about what's best for me. And I can't think of anyone more reliable…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (And sometimes they can be a little sloppy, but never for long. And it's only once in a while.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Not only that, they're also the only reason I was able to meet my hot-blooded rivals and race against them!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (As long as we're together, I feel like I can run full speed ahead toward any dream I come up with!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Someone like that's gotta be…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I gave it a bunch of thought, and I decided that you're so many things to me. It's pretty much impossible to assign you to a single character!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So I thought I should tell you the one thing I know for certain!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If not for you, I never would have become the person I am! And without you, I'll never will become the person I'm going to be! So…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I HOPE YOU'LL STAY BY MY SIDE FOREVER AND EVER!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Carried by her booming voice, her words pierce my heart… and the eardrums of the inn's other occupants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Bamboo Memory and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
